canonical_statement: For every compact Kahler manifold X and every n, its complex de Rham cohomology H^n(X; C) is the internal direct sum of the bidegree pieces H^{p,q}(X) with p + q = n; complex conjugation interchanges H^{p,q}(X) and H^{q,p}(X).

canonical_formal_target.blocker: The statement phase must select or define compact Kahler manifolds, complex de Rham cohomology, and Hodge bidegree subspaces in the pinned Lean environment.

domain_and_universes: A finite-dimensional compact Kahler manifold X; natural numbers n, p, q; complex vector spaces H^n(X; C) and H^{p,q}(X). Lean universes remain deliberately unfrozen until statement elaboration.
hypotheses: X is a compact Kahler manifold
conclusion: H^n(X; C) is the internal direct sum of H^{p,q}(X) over p+q=n, with conjugation symmetry H^{p,q} conjugate to H^{q,p}.

alternate_encodings.target: H^n_dR(X; C) is isomorphic to the direct sum over p+q=n of Dolbeault cohomology H^q(X, Omega^p)
alternate_encodings.relationship: expected equivalent via the Dolbeault theorem

alternate_encodings.target: every complex de Rham cohomology class has a unique harmonic representative, decomposed by type
alternate_encodings.relationship: implies after Hodge and type decomposition

excluded_degenerate_cases: No extra exclusion is intended. n=0 and bidegrees with p>dim_C X or q>dim_C X must be covered by the eventual definitions; noncompact, non-Kahler, and real-coefficient variants are outside this target.
foundation_profile: rev-5.6 Lean 4 default; exact accepted/disallowed axioms deferred to statement and validation phases
tcb_profile: rev-5.6 Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib; no oracle or external computation credited
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on canonical-claim, source, toolchain, dependency, or foundation-profile change; master review is required for acceptance.
